content.short: Minero focuses on NFT tech for business, marketing, authentication and certification.
content.description: Verifying an individual's micro-credentials across multiple platforms quickly can be expensive and time consuming. Founded in Austin in 2022, Minero helps organizations mint their certifications on the blockchain, creating an immutable, verifiable record of qualifications that endures beyond changing platforms. The minting platform is tailored to each organization's specific needs, and Minero guides onboarding for users with or without a wallet, reducing friction and helping teams adopt Web3 more smoothly, securely, and at scale.
